scope: price-model dataset preparation and group-split validation only

preparation.target_leakage_control: Currency and explicitly price-labelled amounts are redacted before TF-IDF and local text embeddings.
preparation.duplicate_policy: Exact target/content duplicates are collapsed, retaining the last occurrence.
preparation.property_group_policy: Explicit property ID, address signature, conservative location/physical-attribute block, then source/listing identity; URL, price and free text are excluded from the group key.

validation.targeted_tests: 18 passed across model, extraction-panel and predictive-gate tests

limitations: This artifact covers preparation only; clean diagnostic scores are reported separately in price-benchmark-grouped-20261118.json.
Legacy rows without durable property IDs use a conservative location/physical-attribute block that may merge distinct similar properties or miss relistings with changed metadata.
The source snapshot contains asking prices, not independently verified transaction prices.
